# appsignal_hosted_collector (Data Source)

An OpenTelemetry collector that AppSignal hosts for the organization, looked up by id, or the organization's default one when id is left out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appsignal_hosted_collector" "this" {
  organization_slug = "example"
}

# Point any OTLP/HTTP exporter at it. Exporters that cannot set resource attributes
# send the app name, environment and push API key as Appsignal-Config-* headers.
output "otlp_endpoint" {
  value = data.appsignal_hosted_collector.this.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_slug` (String)

### Optional

- `id` (String) Leave out for the organization's default hosted collector.

### Read-Only

- `experimental` (Boolean) Whether it runs AppSignal's experimental build.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `region` (String)
- `status` (String) Such as `provisioned`.
- `subdomain` (String)
- `url` (String) Base URL that OTLP/HTTP exporters send to; signals go to `/v1/traces`, `/v1/metrics` and `/v1/logs`.
